beats.label: Cranberry vs plaque
beats.text: Your cranberry juice is probably the **wrong** **one.**

beats.label: Myth
beats.text: All fruit juice is just **bad** **news** for your teeth.

beats.label: What researchers found
beats.text: Swishing **100%** **unsweetened** cranberry juice slowed plaque **regrowth** and **acid** within 30 minutes.
beats.note: Wu, Xie et al., Scientific Reports 2026

beats.label: The catch
beats.text: The **sweetened** cranberry cocktail **didn't** show the same effect.

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: Just **22** people, measured over **30** **minutes.** Not proof it prevents **cavities.** Keep **brushing.**
